It’s a 2-in-1 moisturiser with everyday UV protection, giving 72H hydration +  UV protection, with UVA + UVB filters. Plus, it has Vitamin E and Jojoba Oil and feels lightweight, fast-absorbing and non-sticky. ☀️

So yes, you can accuse me of many things… but not of skipping my everyday glow routine. 😉

#EverydayGlowFixWithNIVESoftDailyUV #NIVEASoftDailyUV #NIVEAIndia #EverydaySkincare DailySkincare".
